answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in shale, expire in whisper, and wharf lists each expiry. An adversary running 136 aliases thus needs 75 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3874 identities would post 4483 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
